visualCharacteristics: Masonry grid of cards (1 column mobile, 2/3/4 columns at 768/1024/1112) with image, category, title and abstract; hero, hover, event and product card types; optional Load more pager and dark ink band.
contentPattern: One row per card: optional card-type cell (e.g. hero, thumb-1-1, thumb-2-3, hover, event, logo, span-N) | pictures | heading with card link, category paragraph, optional date and abstract; an optional final row with a single paragraph is the pager label.
usage: Use for a masonry wall of linked content cards such as insights listings, news or event grids.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for listing or hub pages by authoring one row per card, setting an optional card-type cell to control each card's layout.
